name: [UPD]🪓 Mini Choppers
desc:
🪓 Welcome to Mini Choppers! 🌲

Start with a tiny forest and grow into the ULTIMATE chopping empire! Spawn powerful choppers, automate your production, and make BILLIONS of coins while unlocking insane upgrades! 💰🔥

✨ WHY PLAY?
🌱 Satisfying tree growing & harvesting
🪓 Tons of unique choppers to unlock
⚡ Super fast progression & upgrades
💸 Huge money boosts and multipliers
🏝️ Explore new areas and expand your empire
🏆 Compete on global leaderboards
🎁 Rewards, secrets, and future updates

From a single tree to a massive automated lumber factory… how far can YOU go? 👀

👍 LIKE + ⭐ FAVORITE for codes & updates!
🔔 Join the group for rewards!
